question: What claim about the speaker's intention must hold if the arrangement of the yoginī row is said to be told to the beloved?
premises: The speaker intends to tell the arrangement of the yoginī row.
The teaching is directed to that addressee.
inference: The speaker promises to disclose the arrangement of the yoginī row to the beloved addressee.
uncertainties: The full content of the arrangement is not given by this verse alone.
plain_english: O beloved, I shall tell you the arrangement of the yoginī row.
